1. If you review with background music, make sure it has no lyrics so it won’t disrupt your comprehension.

2. Learn to read, understand, highlight, write, then read and understand again as many times as needed so you don’t forget the topic right after studying it.

3. Don’t feel too pressured. Keep your review journey private, but not secret.

4. Enjoy the process—don’t make your study time feel like punishment.

5. Use spaced repetition. Instead of cramming, revisit topics after a day, after a week, and after a few weeks. This strengthens long-term memory and helps you retain information more effectively.
